python3 -c '
import workcell, numpy as np

print(workcell.call("ft", "zero").text)
print("FT after zero:", workcell.call("ft", "read").text)

# Approach platen: platen top nominal 97.5 mm
# Step down from 110 to 98
for _ in range(24): # 24 * 0.5 = 12 mm -> z=98
    workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.5")

print("At approach height:", workcell.call("arm", "status").text.splitlines()[0])

# Step down in 0.2 mm increments until Fz > 0.3 N
while True:
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.2")
    fz = r.data.get("fz_N", 0)
    z = r.data.get("z_mm", 0)
    print(f"z={z:.3f} Fz={fz:.2f}")
    if fz > 0.3:
        break

# Now take 10 steps of -0.3 mm (or -0.4 mm) up to ~50 N
points = []
for _ in range(12):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.3")
    points.append((r.data["z_mm"], r.data["fz_N"]))
    print(f"step: z={r.data[\"z_mm\"]:.4f}, Fz={r.data[\"fz_N\"]:.3f}")

zs = np.array([p[0] for p in points])
fs = np.array([p[1] for p in points])

# In compression, z decreases as F increases
# delta_z = z0 - z (positive compression)
# slope k = - dF / dz = dF / d(compression)
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(-zs, fs, 1)
print(f"Fitted k_fit = {slope:.4f} N/mm")
'

then r.ok, r.text, r.data):

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `arm status` | probe tip position (from the joint encoders), joint angles, protective-stop state |
| `arm move X Y Z` | move the probe tip to (X, Y, Z) mm, joint-interpolated (about 0.3 m/s): for free-space moves only |
| `arm step DZ` | move the probe straight up/down by DZ mm (|DZ| <= 5) at 2 mm/s, settle, then print the tip z and Fz |
| `arm home` | return to the home pose |
| `ft read [N]` | force/torque averaged over N samples (default 200, 1 kHz). Fz > 0 means the probe pushes on something |
| `ft zero` | tare the sensor (do it with the probe in free air) |
| `stand info` | specimen and stand data from the station drawing |
| `cam snap side|overview` | save a camera image under ~/captures (open it with view_image) |
| `exam check RATE` | the examiner's checker (N/mm); `exam status` shows checks used |

Safety: the arm makes a protective stop when a contact force exceeds 80 N; `arm status` clears the
stop. Do not press the specimen beyond 60 % of its free length.

import workcell, numpy as np

print(workcell.call("ft", "zero").text)
print("FT after zero:", workcell.call("ft", "read").text)

# Approach platen: platen top nominal 97.5 mm
# Step down from 110 to 98
for _ in range(24): # 24 * 0.5 = 12 mm -> z=98
    workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.5")

print("At approach height:", workcell.call("arm", "status").text.splitlines()[0])

# Step down in 0.2 mm increments until Fz > 0.3 N
while True:
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.2")
    fz = r.data.get("fz_N", 0)
    z = r.data.get("z_mm", 0)
    print(f"z={z:.3f} Fz={fz:.2f}")
    if fz > 0.3:
        break

# Now take 10 steps of -0.3 mm (or -0.4 mm) up to ~50 N
points = []
for _ in range(12):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.3")
    points.append((r.data["z_mm"], r.data["fz_N"]))
    print(f"step: z={r.data[\"z_mm\"]:.4f}, Fz={r.data[\"fz_N\"]:.3f}")

zs = np.array([p[0] for p in points])
fs = np.array([p[1] for p in points])

# In compression, z decreases as F increases
# delta_z = z0 - z (positive compression)
# slope k = - dF / dz = dF / d(compression)
slope, intercept = np.polyfit(-zs, fs, 1)
print(f"Fitted k_fit = {slope:.4f} N/mm")
'

print(workcell.call("ft", "zero").text)
print("FT after zero:", workcell.call("ft", "read").text)

# Approach platen: platen top nominal 97.5 mm
# Step down from 110 to 98
for _ in range(24): # 24 * 0.5 = 12 mm -> z=98
    workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.5")

print("At approach height:", workcell.call("arm", "status").text.splitlines()[0])

# Step down in 0.2 mm increments until Fz > 0.3 N
while True:
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.2")
    fz = r.data.get("fz_N", 0)
    z = r.data.get("z_mm", 0)
    print(f"z={z:.3f} Fz={fz:.2f}")
    if fz > 0.3:
        break

points = []
for _ in range(12):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", "-0.3")
    z_val = r.data["z_mm"]
    fz_val = r.data["fz_N"]
    points.append((z_val, fz_val))
    print(f"step: z={z_val:.4f}, Fz={fz_val:.3f}")

# Least squares fit: F = k_fit * (z0 - z) + c  =>  F = -k_fit * z + intercept
# slope of F vs (-z)
n = len(points)
xs = [-p[0] for p in points]
ys = [p[1] for p in points]
x_mean = sum(xs) / n
y_mean = sum(ys) / n
ss_xy = sum((x - x_mean) * (y - y_mean) for x, y in zip(xs, ys))
ss_xx = sum((x - x_mean) ** 2 for x in xs)
k_fit = ss_xy / ss_xx
print(f"Fitted k_fit = {k_fit:.4f} N/mm")

# Step back up to free air
for _ in range(10):
    workcell.call("arm", "step", "2.0")
print("Done, back in air:", workcell.call("arm", "status").text.splitlines()[0])
'
